title: Fixing Forties
summary:
Pipeline outage shuffles crude oil trade in the North Sea
On Monday 11 December, the Forties Pipeline System (FPS) in the North Sea was closed for repairs. The 235-mile pipeline transports about 450,000 barrels of oil per day (b/d) on average, which is about 40% of UK production. It is one of the oldest pipeline systems in the North Sea.
